name: SYMMETRIC_MATRIX_SUBGRID_ISOMORPHISM
description: Transforms the independent set problem on a graph into finding a principal submatrix of a symmetric matrix such that all its off-diagonal elements are zero. By removing graph terminology (nodes, edges, independent set, conflicts) and replacing it with matrix terminology (rows, columns, cells, subgrid), models relying on surface pattern matching fail to map the problem to a graph and thus fail to use the necessary optimized algorithms (like Bron-Kerbosch).
